d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri Samrat Choudhary se Manish Kashyap ne apni hone vali patni Anushka Sharma ke sath mulakat ki. is dauran donon ne mukhyamantri ko shrimadbhagvadgita bhent ki aur unka aashirvad liya. aakhir is mulakat men kya batchit huee aur Manish Kashyap ne soshal midiya par kya bataya? dekhie puri khabar.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
